craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta of totality; vyabhicāri wonder at all-directions-all-things listed. Sanskrit-first: paryanta (UTTERMOST — kept; running-to-the-end is the doctrine); ūrdhva-adhas-tiryak (HIGH-LOW-ATHWART — three directions kept technical). Rows: 9 (total inventory kept UNCOMPRESSED — completeness IS the point per C1), 2 (direction-compounds unpacked), 1 (‘mind’ closes — inner last: outer→inner order kept). Close: ‘pleasure, pain, and mind’. Rupture: em-dash (extremes turn to inventory). Rejected: ‘all extremes’ compression — killed: uncompressed IS completeness; ‘sideways’ — killed: athwart technical; ‘beings’ for ‘things’ — killed: bhāva kept things. Read aloud: IN-them, va-RI-e-ty RUNS to the UTT-er-most — HIGH, LOW, a-THWART … WORLDS and their FRAG-ments, PLEA-sure, PAIN, and MIND.

lines: In them, variety runs to the uttermost — high, low, athwart;
worlds and their fragments, pleasure, pain, and mind.
l4.sanskrit_cite: teṣu vaicitryam atyantam ūrdhvādhas tiryag eva yat | bhuvanāni tadaṃśāś ca sukhaduḥkhamatiś ca yā

reads_against.argmap: How far does variety run? → Total inventory, uncompressed: completeness is the point.
c1_essence: Variety totalized: extremes, three directions, outer-inner one list.
